name: DHT Analyzer
author: levywave
description: Decodes the DHT11 / DHT12 / DHT22(AM2302) single-wire temperature & humidity protocol and shows 'RH 33% / T 28 C' bubbles. Needs the built-in Simple Parallel analyzer as an edge sampler (Clock = the DHT data line, Clock Edge = Falling, D0 = the same line). Documentation in English and Chinese (中文).
